question: Which country hosted the FIFA World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qatar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The FIFA World Cup 2022 was hosted by **Qatar**.
 
• This was the first time the World Cup was held in the Middle East.
 
• The tournament took place from **November 20 to December 18, 2022**.
 
• Qatar invested heavily in infrastructure, including the construction of new stadiums, for the event.
 
• The decision to host the World Cup in Qatar was made by FIFA in **2010**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The FIFA World Cup is held every four years and is one of the most prestigious tournaments in international football.
 
• Qatar's bid to host the World Cup was part of its broader strategy to showcase its development and modernity on the global stage.
 
• The tournament was held in winter to avoid the extreme heat of the Qatari summer.
 
• Qatar faced several challenges, including concerns over workers' rights and logistics, but successfully hosted the event.
 
• The 2022 World Cup featured 32 teams from around the world competing for the championship.
